<!-- Adding a blog post? Fill this in. Otherwise delete it. -->

**Post:** `_posts/YYYY-MM-DD-...md`

- [ ] My id is in `_data/authors.yml` and the post has `author: <my-id>`
- [ ] The filename date matches the `date:` in the front matter
- [ ] Images are in `images/blog/<post-filename>/` and each is under 2 MB
- [ ] I previewed it locally (`bundle exec jekyll serve`) or checked the rendered Markdown on GitHub
- [ ] Nothing unpublished/confidential (results under review, student data, etc.)
